title: PIMCO策略师：中期选举后市场为何偏爱分裂政府？
speaker: Tony Crescenzi

segments.en: But do you think this is a moment for junkier bonds in the AI space that people are going to be more specific, pickier about what credit looks like before they make this?
segments.zh: 但你认为现在是AI领域垃圾债的时刻吗？人们会在行动前对信用状况更具体、更挑剔吗？

segments.en: And it's in recent weeks with the lower tier performing, underperforming, it's being socialized. The story is being socialized, so it will make it more difficult for those that do not have the clear cash flow story to borrow money.
segments.zh: 最近几周，较低层级表现不佳，这正在被社会化。这个故事正在被社会化，所以会让那些没有清晰现金流故事的借款方更难借钱。

segments.en: Now, cash flow in the end, what I'm talking about, is simply revenue. Money to pay the bond investor back. Money to pay the bond investor the interest he or she had expects every few months or every six months or every year.
segments.zh: 最终，我说的现金流就是收入。偿还债券投资者的钱。支付债券投资者预期每几个月、每半年或每年获得的利息的钱。

segments.en: So it's sort of moving in that direction that the bond investor is simply imposing discipline again. But being socialized, it'll just make it more difficult for the lower end of the rung.
segments.zh: 所以正朝着那个方向发展，债券投资者再次施加纪律。但被社会化后，只会让较低层级的借款方更难。

segments.en: How are you thinking about the upcoming election you're just talking with Chris Papis who's running for Senate seat up in New Hampshire, been talking about this expectation among Democrats that they'll take over the House, maybe the Senate's more in play than they would have assumed. How do you think about what that means for policy?
segments.zh: 你如何看待即将到来的选举？你刚和在新罕布什尔州竞选参议员的克里斯·帕皮斯交谈，谈到民主党人预期他们将拿下众议院，参议院可能比他们想象的更有戏。你认为这对政策意味着什么？

segments.en: Were there to be a complete turnover in control of Congress? Well, history is clear at this. Investors love divided government.
segments.zh: 如果国会控制权完全更迭呢？嗯，历史在这一点上很明确。投资者喜欢分裂政府。

segments.en: It's 1938. The S&P 500 has increased in value in the one year period after midterm elections. So from November of 26th to November of 27th, the odds are, based on history, that the stock market will rally.
segments.zh: 自1938年以来，标普500在中期选举后一年内都会升值。所以从26年11月到27年11月，基于历史，市场上涨的概率很大。

segments.en: But why is that? Is that because they know the government can't get any regulations done? Because you can't get in the... The US is a capitalist society and capitalists like government to be out of the way.
segments.zh: 但为什么？是因为他们知道政府无法完成任何监管吗？因为无法...美国是资本主义社会，资本家喜欢政府不挡道。

segments.en: And in the midterm point, it usually is out of the way, because it can't be no legislation to turn things.
segments.zh: 在中期选举时，政府通常不挡道，因为不会有立法来改变事情。
